arguments.code:
doc=App.getDocument("hook_lesson5")
sh=doc.Spreadsheet
sh.set("B1","=55 mm"); doc.recompute()
for o in doc.Objects:
    if o.TypeId.startswith(("PartDesign","Sketcher","Spreadsheet")) and o.State: print("STATE",o.Name,o.State)
b=doc.Body; S=b.Shape
print("valid",S.isValid(),"solids",len(S.Solids),"shells",len(S.Shells),"tip",b.Tip.Name)
bb=S.BoundBox; print("bbox",bb)
sk=doc.Sketch
print("sketch pts",[(round(g.StartPoint.x,3),round(g.StartPoint.y,3)) for g in sk.Geometry])
print("sketch solve/DoF",sk.solve(), getattr(sk,'FullyConstrained',None))
# opening / thickness / lip / plate from sketch
import FreeCAD
print("opening",sk.Geometry[3].StartPoint.x-sk.Geometry[5].StartPoint.x)
print("plate thick",sk.Geometry[5].StartPoint.x-sk.Geometry[7].StartPoint.x, "base",sk.Geometry[3].StartPoint.y, "lip wall",sk.Geometry[1].StartPoint.x-sk.Geometry[3].StartPoint.x)
print("plate h",bb.ZMax-bb.ZMin,"width",bb.YLength,"lip h",sk.Geometry[1].EndPoint.y)
# holes
for f in S.Faces:
    if f.Surface.__class__.__name__=="Cylinder":
        print("hole d",2*f.Surface.Radius,"axis",f.Surface.Axis,"centre",f.Surface.Center, "fillet?" ) 
# fillet radius
for f in S.Faces:
    if f.Surface.__class__.__name__=="Cylinder" and abs(f.Surface.Radius-2)<1e-6: print("fillet r",f.Surface.Radius,"at",f.CenterOfMass)
print("fillet obj",doc.Fillet.Base[1],doc.Fillet.Radius)
print("hole sk",doc.Sketch001.Placement, [(g.Center.x,g.Center.y,g.Radius) if hasattr(g,'Center') else g for g in doc.Sketch001.Geometry])
print("exprs ok", [(o.Name,o.ExpressionEngine) for o in (doc.Sketch,doc.Pad,doc.Hole)])
print("vol",S.Volume)
